item.title: EasyRoute
item.description: Links GitHub repo Description EasyRoute is a REST API service built in Rust that generates personalized walking and cycling routes enriched with points of interest. Given a starting location and a target distance, it creates loop or point-to-point routes that pass through monuments, viewpoints, parks, museums, and other interesting places. The routing engine combines PostGIS spatial queries for POI discovery with Mapbox for turn-by-turn directions. A waypoint selection algorithm picks relevant stops along the route and scores alternatives based on POI density and route quality.
